fusions.name: From the Floorboards
fusions.desc: Bursts out of hiding onto one target for 30 damage as a guaranteed critical hit, consuming every affliction on it and adding their remaining damage to the blow. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Underfoot Scramble
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 5 tiles and scurries between the legs of up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and turning them against each other for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Troop Goes Quiet
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Gathered Nerve
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
